scope: Live cloud runtime checks on one configured synthetic 150-parcel deployment.
not_claimed: A clean end-to-end installer run using the final source revision.
Validation in every tenant, subscription, model or dataset size.
A new multi-model experiment or a rerun of the scenario-3 calculation tools.
Live cleanup, production performance, complete hosted tracing or two-person approval.
method_notes: Acceptance scripts ran on the operator computer; runtime scoring, MCP tools and verification ran in Azure/Fabric/Foundry.

The Function-only patch has deployment/package identity and post-publication probes in verify-unknown-entity-fix.json; the separate artifacts are not represented as one uninterrupted installer invocation.
Question correctness does not establish a usefulness advantage or a new model-comparison result.
Original raw evidence is preserved locally; exports omit private parameters, endpoint/tenant/workspace identities and local paths. Embedded target links are replaced with [target link omitted].
Provider moderation annotations in ontology tool output are retained; all_matched refers to answer correctness, not proof that moderation succeeded.
